subject.title: fix(memory-search): stop hybrid fusion from discounting vector-only multimodal results

question: Should OpenClaw accept modality-aware hybrid fusion that lets vector-only image/audio memories rank by their vector score under default hybrid search?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well covered, but it intentionally changes which persisted multimodal memories can be selected into agent context for existing opt-in multimodal users.

options.title: Accept Modality-Aware Fusion
options.body: Land this PR as the targeted fix for synthetic media labels discounting strong vector-only matches.

options.title: Pause For Ranking Policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want default hybrid ranking to continue favoring text matches until a broader memory-ranking policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept Modality-Aware Fusion
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the targeted fix for synthetic media labels discounting strong vector-only matches.
